Architect's decisions: docs/store-profiles/00-program-2026-09-07.md (F1 one DB per profile, F2 nano-banana-2 primary / flux-2-pro fallback / flux-1.1-pro-ultra raw for lifestyle, F3 bytes re-hosted to apps/backend/static + raw archive never deleted, F4 preset on the canon dictionary with the 88-variable bridge, F5 classic card in wave 1, F6 pilot = sneakers, F7 en+de/fr/es/ru, F8 stand :9023/:8028 in worktree feat/store-profiles). Proposed goal: the storefront on http://localhost:8028/en reads as a real sneaker brand's shop seeded from data/profiles/sneakers (14 products, sizes × colourways, ≥3 generated images each, copy matching the renders, own theme, hero and category tiles), verified from a fresh DB. Proposed acceptance (machine): store-profile:validate sneakers green with counts | seed into a fresh DB prints N products / M variants / K images | every image URL 200 | tsc, next lint, next build green | seed and storefront unit tests + Playwright profile specs green with reverse runs red | T0h.5 four-page pixel delta ≤ 0.1 % on medusa/light | verify report artifacts/docs/2026-09-07-store-profile-sneakers-verify.json with every check and its reverse run, counts copied. Proposed acceptance (Ivan's eyes on :8028): home reads as a sneaker brand's shop (photo banner + headline + button, four category tiles, product shelf) | one product's four photos show the same shoe and the swatches match the photos | every title names what its photo shows | descriptions read as written by a shop | size and colourway selectable, price changes | one palette on home, listing, product, cart | no clipped title or price at phone width. Orchestrator brief: docs/prompts/initial-prompt-2026-09-07-orchestrator-store-profiles.md. Estimates: est-store-profiles-pilot-sneakers, est-store-profiles-wave2-nine (@upready/estimation). Wave 2 (nine profiles, T0j card variants, T0i panel) starts only after Ivan accepts the pilot.

Ivan 2026-09-07 (after the cost breakdown): «давай пока только по 1 кадру все» → the pilot renders ONE frame per product (hero shot only; no angle, detail, lifestyle or colourway shots), one hero banner render, one render per category tile = 19 renders, at most 57 with regenerations (was 90–160). Acceptance lines replaced accordingly: 'every product has ≥1 image that loads' and 'on a product page the photo shows the shoe and the colourway named by the title and swatch'; layout hover = none. Brief S2/S3/S4/S5/S7, program F9/§5/§7/§8/§9, schemas (images minItems 1, shots minItems 1, counts.images min 10) and the estimate (tokens $16–47, renders 19–57) updated in the same turn.
